events.title: Live: the solo dev plays Raise, Rise & Die (Next Fest)
events.summary: Tonight I play Raise, Rise & Die live, during Steam Next Fest.An Arena run on the current beta of the game, a little further than the demo goes.The two rules that make the game: your Top Soul (the top card of your deck, face up, that breaks when you get hit) and the sacrifice (every card you play is paid for with another one).The contest: the top 3 on the solo demo leaderboard by Oct 26, 17:00 UTC win an Early Access key. events.title: Live in French: the solo dev plays Raise, Rise & Die
events.summary: This live stream is in French: the solo dev plays Raise, Rise & Die and answers questions during Steam Next Fest.An English stream follows later today, at 1:30 PM PDT / 4:30 PM EDT, on this page.The free demo is on this page, and the Next Fest contest is running: the top 3 on the solo demo leaderboard by Oct 26, 17:00 UTC win an Early Access key.

events.title: Next Fest demo contest: top 3 win an Early Access key
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is open, and so is a contest. How it worksLaunch the free demo from Steam. Play Arena Solo: 4 fights, then Aberration, the Guardian. Your score goes to the solo demo leaderboard, linked to your Steam account. The 3 highest scores on October 26, 17:00 UTC each win a key for Raise, Rise & Die, delivered when Early Access launches. events.title: Demo update: straight into the fight
events.summary: The demo just got a quicker start.Your first fight is the tutorialOn your first run, seven short tips cover the essentials during your first fight: filling your Reserve by sacrificing cards, the three card types, and how to answer the monster's cards. None of them stops the fight, and "I already know this" skips them at any time. Win the fight, and the run keeps going with the same character and the same deck.The full tutorial is still there, from the main menu, whenever you want the details.You
